How to start

Just talk to it.

No perfect prompt. No formula. Talk to AI like a colleague.

How I start

I tell AI three things

1

Who I am

"I'm an ESOL teacher in New Zealand."

2

Who it's for

"My Level 1 adult learners, migrants in New Zealand."

3

What I want

"A visual, student-centred lesson on transport, with less teacher talk."

Step 3 · Adjust · press → for each message

Then I look and adjust

"Make the font bigger."

"This is still too teacher-centred."

"Add more pair work."

"Too difficult. Add more scaffolding."

Start naturally→ See the result→ Adjust→ Improve

Putting it together · press → line by line

3 lines + 1 adjustment

My message
Who I amI'm an ESOL teacher in Auckland.
Who it's forMy Level 1 class — adult migrants living in New Zealand.
What I wantMake a 10-minute warm-up about how we get around — bus, train, car — with lots of speaking.
Adjust"Make it shorter and use more pictures."

Claude Code: web or installed?

🌐 On the web

claude.ai/code

  • ✅ Nothing to install
  • ✅ Any browser — even my phone
  • ☁️ Works in the cloud
  • 🚫 Can't see files on my computer

Good for: making a web page, a game, fixing my website

💻 Installed on my computer

the Claude desktop app

  • ⬇ Download and install once
  • 💻 Runs on my own computer
  • 📂 Can open my files and folders
  • 🔌 My computer needs to be on

Good for: "Find my Zoom recording." "Organise my Downloads."

Need the files on my computer? → use the installed app.

The chef or the renovator?

👩‍🍳

Cowork

The chef — cooks you a new dish

Starts froman idea · my notes · a coursebook page
Makessomething new — a game, a worksheet, a lesson
Feels likeordering a new dish 🍽️
🧰

Claude Code

The renovator — fixes the house you live in

Starts fromsomething that already exists — my website, my apps, my files
Changesonly what I ask — "fix the tap, don't touch the kitchen"
Safetyit tests the fix · I can go back to the old version
🤝 The same: same Claude brain · same plain English · both do the work, not just talk about it
🧰 When I call the renovator:
🔊"The sound button doesn't work on iPhone. Fix it."
📅"Change the timetable on all 12 pages."
📱"Make my class website work on phones."
🧩"Add a quiz page that looks like the others."
↗ Claude Code
